items.translation: HttpServiceGroupConfigurer.ClientCallback 在 org.springframework.web.service.registry 中的用法

items.source:
Support for creating a registry of HTTP Service client proxies, and declaring
the proxies as beans.
items.translation: 支持创建 HTTP 服务客户端代理的注册表，并将这些代理声明为 Bean。

items.source:
Callback to customize the client builder for every group matched by
the specified name or predicate filters, or to all groups
if no filters are specified.
items.translation: 回调以针对由指定名称或谓词过滤器匹配的每个组自定义客户端构建器，或者如果未指定过滤器则针对所有组。
